Service tests cover write ownership, defensive pagination and legacy behavior; N6.3.D tests cover invalid/inactive owner paths.

Security/audit tests cover exact Sucursales permissions, fail-closed controller authorization, owner reassignment audit and no false audit success on failed persistence.
The list template exposes an accessible Empresa filter label, visible Empresa owner column/card value and explicit legacy-unassigned state without presenting the query filter as authorization.
